name: exercise ball hip flexor stretch
description: A supported lunge stretch using a stability ball beneath the hips. Move the hips forward to stretch the hip flexors of the rear leg.
instructions: Place a stability ball beneath your hips and step one foot forward into a supported lunge.
Reach the other leg back with its toes on the floor, using the ball to support your weight.
Keep your torso tall and gently shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the rear hip.
Hold without arching your lower back, then switch legs.
